# Innogenio

> Innogenio is a design and technology agency that builds custom software,
> AI & automation systems, ERP implementations, and data platforms for
> enterprises. Design and engineering under one roof — from first sketch
> to production, deployment, and ongoing support.

## Services

- **Custom software**: product engineering from first sketch to production — web, mobile, and APIs built to scale.
- **AI & automation**: practical AI that removes busywork — agents, document intelligence, and workflow automation in production.
- **ERP implementation**: ERPNext, Zoho, and Odoo rollouts tailored to how a business actually runs.
- **Data, DevOps & IoT**: dashboards, pipelines, and connected devices, with the infrastructure and observability to keep them running.

## Industries

Manufacturing (plant-floor ERP, production planning, IoT telemetry),
financial services (automation and analytics for lenders, insurers, and
fintechs), retail & D2C (commerce platforms, inventory sync, customer
analytics), and healthcare & education (compliant systems, records, and
portals).

## How we work

Four phases — discovery & planning, UI/UX design, development, and
deployment & support — with fixed scope, weekly demos, and post-launch
iteration. Enterprise-grade hosting, monitoring, launch support, and
SOC 2 / HIPAA / GDPR-ready compliance are built in.
